photos.file: Red-capped Robin, Milbrulong State Forest, NSW.jpg
photos.desc: Male Red-capped Robin (Petroica goodenovii), Milbrulong State Forest, NSW
Another first for me, we dont get these up North. Fairly common here though. The red is so intense it saturates, I lost it a bit trying to fix it. Maybe next time
Strangways Vic. The male of the second pair of these beautiful birds that call our place home.
